history.summary: Young (2023) integrated 2BR directly above Woodleigh MRT and The Woodleigh Mall, priced at $2,111 psf — ~12% below the $2,397 median — on a deep 353-txn base. Genuine transit/retail integration, a low $1.25M quantum and a healthy 3.6%/yr resale rate make this the standout entry in the batch.
history.rating_rationale: 353 transactions give high confidence, the 3.6%/yr resale-only rate is solid for a young 99LH, and at $2,111 psf the unit is ~12% under the $2,397 URA median. Direct NE-line connectivity (290m), Bidadari estate maturation and the on-site Japan-developer (Kajima/SPH) mall underpin both rental demand and resale liquidity; the $1.25M quantum sits in a very lettable, liquid band. Score_1000 658 reaches the recommended tier.
red_flags: 99LH with a soft 2.2%/yr blended URA rate (resale-only is better at 3.6%)
New-launch bias flagged — entry pricing partly developer-set

Bidadari estate maturation and amenity buildout
